A01:2021.name: Broken Access Control
A01:2021.summary: Access control enforces policy such that users cannot act outside of their intended permissions. Failures typically lead to unauthorized information disclosure, modification, or destruction of all data or performing a business function outside the user's limits.

A02:2021.name: Cryptographic Failures
A02:2021.summary: The first thing is to determine the protection needs of data in transit and at rest. Failures related to cryptography often lead to exposure of sensitive data or system compromise.

A03:2021.name: Injection
A03:2021.summary: An application is vulnerable to attack when user-supplied data is not validated, filtered, or sanitized by the application, and hostile data is used directly in dynamic queries or commands.

A04:2021.name: Insecure Design
A04:2021.summary: Insecure design is a broad category representing different weaknesses, expressed as missing or ineffective control design. Insecure design is not the source for all other Top 10 risk categories - there is a difference between insecure design and insecure implementation.

A05:2021.name: Security Misconfiguration
A05:2021.summary: The application might be vulnerable if it is missing appropriate security hardening across any part of the application stack, or has improperly configured permissions on cloud services.

A06:2021.name: Vulnerable and Outdated Components
A06:2021.summary: You are likely vulnerable if you do not know the versions of all components you use, including nested dependencies, or if the software is unsupported, out of date, or not scanned for vulnerabilities.

A07:2021.name: Identification and Authentication Failures
A07:2021.summary: Confirmation of the user's identity, authentication, and session management is critical to protect against authentication-related attacks. Applications may be vulnerable where they use plain text, encrypted, or weakly hashed passwords, or expose credentials.

A08:2021.name: Software and Data Integrity Failures
A08:2021.summary: Software and data integrity failures relate to code and infrastructure that does not protect against integrity violations. An insecure deserialization flaw occurs when an application deserializes hostile or tampered objects supplied by an attacker.

A09:2021.name: Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
A09:2021.summary: Logging and monitoring failures, coupled with missing or ineffective integration with incident response, allow attackers to further attack systems, maintain persistence, and extract or destroy data. Logs of applications and APIs are not monitored for suspicious activity, and logs may themselves store sensitive data.
